book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIKHEHNAH

content: Thlawpaw lang lahsong sahlo
Ato lehei co, uny sahlo, Thlawpaw lahsong sahlo kong hnipase lytah naa ungpaw du bei neh.
Lawki cawngsaw sahlo naa za cang ning takhei co, a rei a thlaw thai lypaw nono a huhang takhei ca tepahnei he ka, ama behnah lang khah lang naa pave tah cawh naa hni.

Macawtaco Khazing Thlawpaw bawngná tei bia a reipaw cawngsaw taco, “Zisu cawh chiasah cang seh,” tah be ca ka, Thlawpaw Pathai tah cy ly co ahotahmai, “Zisu cawh Abui a cang,” tah khy bei he tah heh ka ca ching he.
Thlawpaw lahsong cawh a phingphing tah ung hmai seh la, Thlawpaw sangkheh taitah a vongpaw a cang he.
Raihrenah cawh a phingphing tah ung hmai seh la, a rai kaa hrepahpaw cawh Abuipaw pakheh khah a cang.
Rai cawh a phingphing tah ung hmai seh la, ma Khazing pakheh taco, ma vytei rai cawh ming vytei khah a hresah khypaw he a cang.
Zawpui chahnah cawtah khei Thlawpaw a langchuanah khah pakheh cy peh a cang he.
Ma Thlawpaw takhei pakhehpaw cawh singnah bia khah pei ka, pakhehpaw cawh hnithainah bia khah a peh.
Ma Thlawpaw sangkheh taco a hringpaw cawngsaw pakheh cawh zingnah khah pei ka, ahringpaw cawngsaw khah dangsah khynah lahsong khah ma Thlawpaw thly thly taco a peh.

Pakheh cawh ningang chuipaw hmingtuakhynah khah pei ka, pakheh cawh biaphyhlang khynah khah a peh, pakheh cawh thlawpaw sahlo patlia patla khynah khah pei ka, pakheh cawh rei a macangpaw tah biareinah khah pei ka, pakheh cawh rei chingpase khynah khah a peh.
Ma sahlo vytei heh a maekhehpaw Thlawpaw sangkheh raihrenah cang ka, Ama tei cang seh a tahpaw hratah pakheh cy khah ma sahlo cawh a peh he.
Pungkheh a caibai hlupui
Pung cawh a caibai hlupui tah tuapaw a cang thlang naná teitah sangkheh cang ka, a caibai cawh a hlupui aa cang thlang naná teitah pungkheh tah a tua he. Ma hraco Khri cawh a cang.

Zecawtamaw tatah kaaning vytei heh pungkheh chung lekhei Thlawpaw sangkheh tah baptisma a ma cangsah. Juda cawngsaw aa cang zong tah, Gental cawngsaw aa cang zong tah, sae aa cang zong tah zalong aa cang zong tah, kaa zongmingtei kaa ting ruapaw tah Thlawpaw sangkheh peh ka cang he peh.
Pung cawh a caibai sangkheh tah tuapaw cang lytah a hlupui tah tuapaw a cang.
Phe tah, “Kama cawh kih ka cang lynah cawtah pung letah a tae bei neh,” tah tua seh la, ma taco pung letei a caibai a cangpaw khah cang lytah ungsah hlui be.
Taico naw tah, “Kama cawh meh ka cang ly cawtah pung letah a tae bei neh,” tah tua seh la, ma taco pung letei a caibai a cangpaw khah cang lytah ungsah hlui be.
Pung heh a pungpui hei meh cang tua seh la, zekhatamaw khua cawh a thui thai a? Pung heh a pungpui hei naw cang tua seh la, zekhatamaw ring cawh a thui thai a?
Canghrasala, Khazing tah a du pawtei hratah a caibai sahlo cawh sangkheh cacy khei pung cung lekhei a chia he.
A caibai vytei heh a lo thlu thlang tua he seh la, pung cawh ung a beh.
Ma hrahei a caibai cawh a hlupui a cang naná tah pung cawh sangkheh cy a cang.
Meh tah kih cawh, “Cah hia bei neh,” tah khy be. Taico lu zong tah phe cawh, “Cah hia bei neh,” tah khy hrá be.
Ma hraco cang lytah pung caibai sahlo letah a thawdia vy katei a ngepaw sahlo heh a hia dangpaw cang he ka,
pasungpanaw tlangtlah ly tei kaa rawhpaw sahlo heh kaa pasungpanaw dang he. Taico, palang rua tah a nge lypaw sahlo khah khungzua he peh ka,

palang tlang a tlahpaw sahlo cawh mingkai pa-ei hia bei he. Canghrasala, Khazing taco pung a caibai sahlo cawh a peitlesah thlu he ka, pasungpanawnah a ung lypaw sahlo khah pasungpanawnah a hlui tah a peh he,
macawtaco pung leco a chaichynah a ungpaw cang be, canghrasala a caibai sahlo taco sangkheh le sangkheh a khingpaw tah zawng a rawh cy a hy.
A caibai sangkheh tah asawnah a ing caco, aa ing hrui thlu, sangkheh khah pasungpanaw a cang caco a lawng hrui thlu he.
Naaning vytei cawh Khri a pung cang he ceh ka, naaning pakheh cy heh a caibai cawh na cang he ceh.
Taico khrisawbu letah Khazing tah a pakhehnah letah apostol sahlo, a pahningnah letah Khazing khuavang sahlo,

a pathungnah letah cawngpahtu sahlo, mataico ningang chuipaw a tuatu sahlo, dangsah thainah lahsong a hnuipaw sahlo, male a baw khypaw sahlo, tlangtlah lerei thainah lahsong a hnuipaw sahlo le rei a macangpaw tah a rei khypaw sahlo khah a thing he.
Apostol cang thlu bei he. Khazing khuavang cang thlu bei he. Cawngpahtu cang thlu bei he. Ningang chuipaw tua thlu bei he.
Dangsah thainah lahsong hnui thlu bei he. Rei thuilypaw tah rei thlu bei he. Rei chingpase rai hre thlu bei he.
Canghrasala, lahsong a biapui vypaw sahlo khah du vy hri my lo. Taico a chaw caipaw langpui cawh atoheh ka ca ching he a.

footnotes.text: Biahrai Tha Khazing khuavang a cang he.
